# VIEW012: property-access

Custom property access mode differs from the project convention

| | |
|---|---|
| Code | `VIEW012` |
| Name | `property-access` |
| Category | [View structure](README.md#view-structure-view) (`VIEW`) |
| Default severity | warning |
| Enabled by default | no |
| Fix available | sometimes |
| Fix safety | unsafe |
| ign-lint equivalent | `PropertyAccessRule` |

## What it does

Checks the `access` mode of every top-level custom property of the view and
of its components against `expected-access`. The access mode is the
`access` of the property's `propConfig` entry (`custom.<name>`); a property
without one is `PUBLIC`. Nothing is checked until `expected-access` is set.

## Why is this bad?

Projects that keep view internals private (or public, for embedding) want
every custom property to follow the same rule. A property with the wrong
access is either reachable from places that should not depend on it, or
hidden from embedding views and scripts that need it.

## Example

With `expected-access = "PRIVATE"`:

```json
{"custom": {"rows": []}}
```

Use instead:

```json
{"custom": {"rows": []}, "propConfig": {"custom.rows": {"access": "PRIVATE"}}}
```

## Options

* `expected-access` (unset by default): `PUBLIC`, `PROTECTED` or `PRIVATE` (case-insensitive).
  Unset: the rule reports nothing.
* `exempt-props` (default `[]`): patterns (`*` and `?` wildcards, everything else literal)
  matched against the property name, `custom.<name>` and the full ign-lint
  path (`root.root.children[0].Card.custom.x`).

## Fix

Unsafe, because the access mode changes who can read and write the
property at run time (a `PRIVATE` property is not sent to the browser, a
`PROTECTED` one cannot be written from it): sets `access` in the existing
`propConfig` entry, adds the entry (and
the `propConfig` object when the owner has none), or for `PUBLIC` removes
the `access` key (or the whole entry when `access` was its only key).

## ign-lint

Equivalent of `PropertyAccessRule` (`expected_access`, `exempt_props`), with
the same messages in `iglint ign-lint`.

## Option reference

Set in `[rules.VIEW012]` of `iglint.toml` (or `[tool.iglint.rules.VIEW012]` in `pyproject.toml`).

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expected-access` | string | none | PUBLIC, PROTECTED or PRIVATE; unset disables the rule. |
| `exempt-props` | array of strings | `[]` | Wildcard patterns of properties that are not checked. |

ign-lint `kwargs` in a `rule_config.json`: `expected_access` -> `expected-access`, `exempt_props` -> `exempt-props`.
